title: Scoped Enablement Tool Discovery and Negative Checks
claim: FP-MCP-306 verified that the FP-MCP-305 scoped enablement tools are discoverable after bridge restart and that stale inputs fail closed: preview was read-only and ineligible, create refused without writing the enablement artifact, and status reported no usable enablement artifact. No guarded run was attempted.
summary: After the operator restarted the MCP bridge service and refreshed actions, api_tool discovery found the new scoped enablement tools: preview, create, and status. A stale FP-MCP-295 tuple using expired FP-MCP-302 approval, expired local clearance CLEARANCE-20260704T145411583Z-29b22ae0, current ForgePilot HEAD 638fbe3, and stale runner capability timestamp 2026-07-04T14:54:29.547Z was used for negative testing. The preview result was read-only and returned eligibleToInvokeEnablementPopup false with reasons including APPROVAL_EXPIRED, CLEARANCE_VALID_FAILED, and RUNNER_CAPABILITY_OBSERVATION_FRESH_FAILED. The create result returned enablementCreated false, enablementMutated false, filesWritten false, approvalUsableForExecution false, and reasons APPROVAL_NOT_USABLE_FOR_SCOPED_ENABLEMENT plus APPROVAL_EXPIRED. The status result reported enablementArtifactPresent false, eligibleForScopedExecutionEnablement false, and no usable local enablement. A terminal check confirmed the MCP bridge working tree is clean at 36c3d5a and .local/forgepilot/execution-enablement.json is absent.
caveats: Only stale/expired negative checks were run; no fresh approval, clearance, or positive enablement was created.
The previous local clearance file still exists but is expired and bound to requestArtifactCommit 9a0b6b7, so it is not usable for current HEAD 638fbe3.
This packet does not integrate scoped enablement into aggregate orientation or guarded preflight reporting.
No attempt was made to contact runner start or start OpenCode.
boundaries: tool discovery and negative checks only
no OpenCode session or worker started
